solution:
names = ["预习提纲", "课堂笔记", "课后总结", "错题重做"]
values = [2, 3, 4, 1]
threshold = 2

picked = []
for i in range(len(names)):
    if values[i] >= threshold:
        picked.append(names[i])

print(picked)
